official_members: BaseProjectileTemplate.o, Projectile.C/H, anti-projectile scan in units/d/p
evidence: CustomUnit copies deflectionPower into H unless it is <0.5, in which case C=true; laser-defence scan skips C projectiles.
The experimental laser projectile sets E=true and initializes J/F; update repeatedly applies directDamage/60*delta*ratio instead of one-shot removal.
drawMainLayer refreshes a random float[20] every four ticks and offsets each line segment in the lighting-effect draw path.
Projectiles without live target are removed unless aC=true; direct ground/linked projectile factories set aC and fixed coordinates.
update() raises height toward aJ until aK is set, then lowers height toward target height near impact; aL controls height interpolation speed or falls back to projectile speed when negative.
impact sets bn=true; area damage gathers nearby units into static scratch list bi before expansion/removal countdowns.
